assertions.subject: Leiomyosarcoma
assertions.quote: leiomyosarcoma is rare, with an estimated incidence of 0.36 per 100,000 woman–years

assertions.subject: Leiomyosarcoma
assertions.quote: The median age at diagnosis of leiomyosarcoma is 54 years, with an interquartile range of 48–63 years

assertions.subject: Leiomyosarcoma
assertions.quote: History of tamoxifen use for more than 5 years is associated with increased risk of endometrial carcinoma and also may increase the risk of leiomyosarcoma

assertions.subject: Leiomyosarcoma
assertions.quote: A history of pelvic irradiation and certain hereditary cancer syndromes, such as hereditary retinoblastoma syndrome and Li Fraumeni syndrome, also are associated with an increased risk of leiomyosarcoma

assertions.subject: Leiomyosarcoma
assertions.quote: Research has shown that uterine size and rapid uterine growth are not associated with increased risk of leiomyosarcoma

assertions.subject: Leiomyosarcoma
assertions.quote: No test can accurately rule out the diagnosis of leiomyosarcoma preoperatively

assertions.subject: Leiomyosarcoma
assertions.quote: the FDA calculated that prevalence was 1 in 352 for unsuspected uterine sarcoma and 1 in 498 for unsuspected leiomyosarcoma in women undergoing hysterectomy or myomectomy for presumed benign leiomyomata
